The Prophet said exaggerated praise cuts a man's neck or back; one should only say 'I think him so', vouching for no one before Allah.
When Um Al-Ala testified that Allah had blessed the dead Uthman bin Mazun, the Prophet said even he did not know what would be done to him.
The Prophet rebuked men who over-praised another, saying they had cut his back or neck; one who must praise should say 'I think', for none can sanctify anyone before Allah.
When a man praised another, the Prophet said thrice that he had cut his brother's neck; one who must praise should say 'I think', for none sanctifies anyone before Allah.
